scope: Standard consumption-tax rate suggestions and U.S. state-level/general estimates. Not a taxability determination.

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.note: Standard VAT rate; zero-rated and exempt supplies can apply.

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.note: Standard VAT rate; zero-rated and exempt supplies can apply.

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.note: Standard VAT is 20%; reduced and zero rates apply to qualifying supplies.

AU.name: Australia
AU.note: GST is 10% on most taxable supplies; GST-free supplies exist.

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.note: GST is 15% on most taxable supplies; some supplies are zero-rated or exempt.

SG.name: Singapore
SG.note: Current GST rate is 9%; zero-rated and exempt supplies exist.

JP.name: Japan
JP.note: Standard rate is 10%; qualifying food and certain newspapers can use the 8% reduced rate.

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.note: Standard VAT remains 15%; zero-rated and exempt supplies exist.

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.note: Normal VAT is 8.1%; 2.6% reduced and 3.8% accommodation rates apply in qualifying cases.

NO.name: Norway
NO.note: Normal VAT is 25%; 15%, 12% and zero rates apply to qualifying categories.

MX.name: Mexico
MX.note: General IVA rate is 16%; zero-rate and exempt cases exist.
